title: Will You Be Taller By Next Christmas?
character: Full-body front-facing character sheet, flat 2D vector illustration style, clean geometric shapes, soft flat colors, white background. A friendly smiling teenage boy with brown messy hair, wearing a mint-green t-shirt, dark charcoal straight-cut pants, and white-soled low-top sneakers. Standing upright, relaxed posture, clean minimal design suitable for motion animation.
voice: Bright, friendly, upbeat and warm educational tone, brisk pacing like a viral science explainer.

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered if you'll grow by Christmas?

figures.pose: Smiling teen boy in mint tee, looking curiously at the height ruler beside him, festive Santa hat on his head
figures.label: This Christmas

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector icon of a wrapped holiday gift box with red ribbon
icons.label: Gifts

scenes.vo: During growth spurts, girls shoot up three inches yearly,

figures.pose: Smiling teen girl in mint tee and ponytail, growing taller against vertical ruler
figures.label: Age 11-12

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector icon of an upward growth green arrow
icons.label: +3 inches

scenes.vo: usually peaking around eleven or twelve years old.

figures.pose: Two teenage girls standing side by side, comparing heights happily
figures.label: Peak Spurt

figures.pose: Second teenage girl in yellow tee, smiling friendly
figures.label: Pre-Spurt

scenes.vo: Boys hit their peak later, around thirteen or fourteen,

figures.pose: Teen boy in mint tee stretching tall with ruler climbing rapidly
figures.label: Age 13-14

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector icon of a decorated holiday pine tree
icons.label: Winter

scenes.vo: gaining up to four full inches in one year!

figures.pose: Teen boy in mint tee looking surprised and excited, hands on hips next to tall ruler mark
figures.label: +4 inches

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector gold trophy cup icon
icons.label: Peak Growth

scenes.vo: Interestingly, teens grow noticeably faster in spring and summer.
scenes.photo: Warm bright sunny outdoor field with golden sunlight flare, a tall adolescent silhouette stretching under bright blue skies, realistic cinematic photography, no text

scenes.vo: Plus, boys keep growing two years longer than girls.

figures.pose: Teen girl standing relaxed at final adult height
figures.label: Age 16

figures.pose: Young adult guy in mint tee standing taller beside her with ruler
figures.label: Age 18

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector calendar icon showing added years
icons.label: +2 Years

scenes.vo: So by next Christmas, you could add several inches!

figures.pose: Teen boy in mint tee wearing Christmas scarf, standing proud next to ruler rising higher
figures.label: Christmas 2026

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector festive sparkle star icon
icons.label: Next Year

scenes.vo: So how tall will YOU be next holiday season?

figures.pose: Teen boy pointing friendly directly at camera with questioning expression and slight head tilt

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector glowing question mark icon
icons.label: Your Height?

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Happy smiling teen boy holding a modern smartphone, waving warmly to the viewer

icons.prompt: flat 2D vector mobile phone icon with growth graph line on screen
icons.label: TallPlan
